item.title: KEN SUSI Walks Away from AS I LAY DYING: "My Morals Hit Their Limit"
item.description: The As I Lay Dying ship seems to be taking on water—fast. First, bassist Ryan Neff jumped overboard, offering little more than a vague farewell. Then whispers started about their European tour vanishing into thin air, allegedly after their tour manager quit.

item.title: Drummer Nick Pierce Leaves As I Lay Dying Citing Health Concerns
item.description: As I Lay Dying seems to be unraveling faster than a cheap sweater at a metal merch stand. The band now consists of just Tim Lambesis and Phil Sgrosso, as drummer Nick Pierce becomes the latest member to exit stage left.

item.title: European Tour Canceled as As I Lay Dying Faces Major Member Departures
item.description: It’s a mass exodus over in the As I Lay Dying camp, with members dropping off faster than you can say “farewell tour.” The band’s entire European tour is scrapped, and not a peep has come from the remaining members—whoever’s still sticking around, that is.

item.title: Ice Nine Kills Drummer Patrick Galante Steps Down
item.description: Ice Nine Kills just lost a piece of their rhythm section, and no, it’s not some dramatic ‘spooky’ horror movie twist. Patrick Galante, who’s been holding down the drum kit since 2018, has decided to hang up his sticks—at least with INK.

item.title: Linkin Park's Mike Shinoda: "This Isn’t a Reunion, It’s a New Chapter"
item.description: Mike Shinoda recently shared more details about Linkin Park’s reformation during an interview with BBC Radio 1’s New Music Show With Jack Saunders. The vocalist and multi-instrumentalist pulled back the curtain on how the band’s new chapter began and what fans can expect moving forward.

item.title: Is Lzzy Hale the Future Voice of Linkin Park? Fans Think So
item.description: Linkin Park has been pulling some real grade-A stunts lately. Countdowns leading to… more countdowns. Announcements that announce other announcements. It’s like watching a toddler try to explain a magic trick—it’s messy, pointless, and you’re not even mad, just confused.

item.title: Countdown Chaos: Is Deryck Whibley Joining Linkin Park?
item.description: The countdown on Linkin Park’s site is ticking, and fans are losing their minds. Again. What is it this time? A new song? A reunion? Nope. The latest theory says Deryck Whibley from Sum 41 is sliding in as their new frontman.

item.title: Did Slipknot’s Website Just Confirm Their New Drummer?
item.description: Slipknot’s grand reveal of their mystery drummer is just days away, set to coincide with their live performance at Sick New World. But a few determined internet detectives might have already beaten the band to the punch.

item.title: Korn's Next Album in 2024 Could Be Their First Without Fieldy
item.description: Korn apparently has some new sounds brewing for 2024, if guitarist Brian “Head” Welch is to be believed. He recently mentioned on The Joe Kingdom Perspective that there’s “new music coming next year,” though it seems like the band is in some kind of self-imposed exile right now, as he put it, “just doing our own thing.

item.title: Jordan Mancino Steps Back: As I Lay Dying Faces Internal Challenges
item.description: The chaos surrounding As I Lay Dying just keeps piling up. After Josh Gilbert made his grand exit, the band scrambled to patch things together by roping in Ryan Neff of Miss May I to cover bass and vocals, while Ken Susi of Unearth stepped in on guitar.
